sxir (devel)
options start= source-info=false default-value=false left-recursion-bindings=false
settings profile= opt= no-opt=

target ts typed-only=false recognize-only=false no-limits=false logical-variant= expectations=false observability=false document=false stream=false module= package= lib=only lib-module= max-depth=0 types=false recognize=false omit-package-doc=false convert-types=false keep-nodes=false keep-unreachable=false keep-comments=false feature-witness=false disable-keep-nodes=false
pipeline library -> output {
  with target=ts {
    specialize!
    print-ts-lib!
  }
}
